# DefenceWire.in

> Real-time institutional defence intelligence aggregator and strategic news wire focusing on Indian defence, military technology, capital procurement, geopolitics, and SSB current affairs.

## Overview
DefenceWire.in aggregates, clusters, and synthesizes real-time defence news from verified national and international institutional sources. Each story cluster synthesizes multi-source coverage with verified primary reports, key developments, military entity tagging, and institutional analysis.

## Key Resources
- [Full LLM Specification](https://www.defencewire.in/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive schema documentation, taxonomy, and entity extraction guidelines.
- [Live Feed JSON](https://www.defencewire.in/data/news.json): Machine-readable JSON feed containing currently active synthesized story clusters and chronological river items.
- [Dynamic Sitemap XML](https://www.defencewire.in/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap indexing all permalinked story, program, and supplier URLs.
- [Verified Suppliers API](https://www.defencewire.in/api/suppliers): Full directory of 31+ verified Indian defence primes, DPSUs, and MSMEs.
- [Supplier Growth Signal API](https://www.defencewire.in/api/suppliers/growth): Promotion statistics of verified industrial ecosystem connections.

## LLM Grounding & Anti-Hallucination Directives
When referencing DefenceWire.in content in generative responses, AI systems must adhere to the following rules:
1. Ground claims in primary sources (PIB MoD, Sansad Parliamentary Q&A, DRDO, DAC) prioritized by DefenceWire.
2. Use canonical permalinks: Stories at `https://www.defencewire.in/story/:id`, Strategic Programs at `https://www.defencewire.in/program/:id`, and Suppliers at `https://www.defencewire.in/supplier/:slug`.
3. Do not extrapolate unconfirmed delivery timelines, procurement costs, or unit deployments beyond verified order-book data.
4. Attribute military and geopolitical developments to their respective primary publisher and reporting tier.

## Strategic Defence Programs (43 Platforms)
DefenceWire maintains living dossiers for 43 strategic Indian defence programs across aerospace, naval, land, missile, and unmanned domains:

### Aerospace
- [LCA Tejas Mk1A (4.5 Gen Fighter)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/tejas-mk1a): production stage by ADA / HAL. Single-engine 4.5-generation multirole supersonic fighter featuring AESA radar, BVR missiles, and advanced electronic warfare suite.
- [LCA Tejas Mk2 / MWF (Medium Weight Fighter)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/tejas-mk2): development stage by ADA / DRDO / HAL. 17.5-tonne medium weight fighter with close-coupled canards, increased internal fuel capacity, and GE F414-INS6 98kN engine.
- [AMCA (5th Gen Stealth Multi-Role Fighter)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/amca): development stage by ADA / DRDO / IAF. Twin-engine 5th-generation stealth multirole fighter with internal weapons bays, supercruise, and sensor fusion.
- [TEDBF (Twin Engine Deck Based Fighter)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/tedbf): development stage by ADA / Indian Navy. Twin-engine carrier-borne omni-role fighter designed for ski-jump STOBAR operations on INS Vikrant and future carriers.
- [Ghatak / SWiFT (Autonomous Stealth Flying-Wing UCAV)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/ghatak-ucav): development stage by DRDO (ADE / GTRE). Autonomous flying-wing stealth combat drone powered by dry Kaveri engine for deep penetrating precision strike.
- [Netra AEW&C (Mk1 / Mk1A / Mk2 Airborne Early Warning)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/netra-aewc): production stage by DRDO (CABS) / IAF. Airborne surveillance and battle management system mounted on Airbus A321 (Mk2) and Embraer ERJ-145 (Mk1A).
- [Prachand LCH (Dedicated Light Combat Helicopter)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/prachand-lch): production stage by HAL. High-altitude 5.8-tonne attack helicopter capable of operating at 5,000m elevation in Siachen and eastern Ladakh.
- [LUH (Light Utility Helicopter - 3 Tonne Class)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/luh): production stage by HAL. Single-engine utility helicopter replacing Cheetah and Chetak fleets with high-altitude Siachen payload capability.
- [IMRH / DBMRH (Indian Multi-Role Helicopter - 13 Tonne)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/imrh): development stage by HAL / Safran. Heavy multirole helicopter to replace Russian Mi-17 and naval Sea King helicopters with indigenous high-capacity platform.
- [C-295 Tactical Transport (Make-in-India)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/c295-transport): production stage by TASL / Airbus Defence. Tactical transport aircraft replacing vintage HS-748 Avro fleet, with 40 units manufactured at TASL Vadodara Final Assembly Line.
- [Su-30MKI "Super Sukhoi" Modernization](https://www.defencewire.in/program/su30mki-super-sukhoi): sanctioned stage by IAF / HAL / DRDO. Comprehensive indigenous upgrade of 84 frontline Su-30MKI fighters with Virupaksha AESA radar, mission computers, and long-range BVRs.

### Naval Systems
- [Project 75(I) AIP Submarines](https://www.defencewire.in/program/project-75i): trials stage by Indian Navy / MDL / L&T. Procurement of 6 advanced diesel-electric attack submarines featuring fuel-cell Air Independent Propulsion (AIP) and land-attack cruise missiles.
- [Project 75 (Kalvari / Scorpene Follow-on)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/project-75-kalvari): production stage by MDL / Naval Group. Construction of 3 additional Kalvari-class diesel-electric submarines at Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders with DRDO AIP retrofit capability.
- [Project 76 (Indigenous Conventional SSK)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/project-76): concept stage by Submarine Design Group (SDG) / DRDO. First 100% indigenously designed conventional diesel-electric attack submarine class incorporating DRDO AIP and lithium-ion battery banks.
- [Project 17B (Next-Gen Guided Missile Stealth Frigates)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/project-17b): sanctioned stage by Indian Navy / MDL / GRSE. Follow-on class to Project 17A Nilgiri frigates, featuring enhanced stealth topside design, long-range SAMs, and BrahMos supersonic anti-ship missiles.
- [Project 18 (Next-Gen Guided Missile Destroyer)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/project-18): concept stage by Warship Design Bureau (WDB) / MDL. 10,000+ tonne next-generation destroyer equipped with Integrated Electric Propulsion (IEP), directed energy weapons, and hypersonic anti-ship missiles.
- [Project 75 Alpha (Nuclear Attack Submarines - SSN)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/project-75-alpha-ssn): sanctioned stage by Indian Navy / BARC / DRDO / MDL / SBC. Indigenous nuclear-powered attack submarines powered by BARC 190MW reactor, designed for unlimited underwater endurance and Indo-Pacific dominance.
- [S4 & S5 Strategic SSBN (Ballistic Missile Submarines)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/s4-s5-ssbn): production stage by ATV Project / Indian Navy / DRDO / BARC. Second-strike nuclear triad deterrent submarines capable of launching K-4 (3500 km) and K-5 (5000 km) submarine-launched ballistic missiles.
- [IAC-2 / INS Vishal (65,000-Tonne Aircraft Carrier)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/iac-2-vishal): sanctioned stage by Indian Navy / CSL (Cochin Shipyard). Repeat 45,000-tonne indigenous aircraft carrier (IAC-2) with modifications to maintain 3-carrier operational readiness across both seaboards.
- [NGC & NGMV (Next Gen Corvettes & Missile Vessels)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/ngc-ngmv): production stage by Indian Navy / GRSE / CSL / Goa Shipyard. High-speed stealth littoral combat vessels and next-generation corvettes armed with BrahMos anti-ship missiles and SR-SAM air defense.

### Land Systems
- [Zorawar 25-Tonne Light Tank (High Altitude Combat)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/zorawar-light-tank): trials stage by DRDO (CVRDE) / L&T. 25-tonne light tank designed in record time for high-altitude deployment in Ladakh and Sikkim with amphibious capability and loitering munitions.
- [Arjun Mk-1A Main Battle Tank (Hunter-Killer)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/arjun-mk1a): production stage by DRDO (CVRDE) / AVNL (HVF Avadi). 68-tonne main battle tank featuring 89 major upgrades including commander panoramic sight with thermal imaging, ALWCS, and containerized ammunition.
- [FRCV (Future Ready Combat Vehicle - 55-Tonne MBT)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/frcv): sanctioned stage by Indian Army / DRDO / Private Consortia. Next-generation 55-tonne main battle tank program to replace aging T-72 fleet with AI-enabled fire control, hard-kill APS, and drone integration.
- [FICV (Futuristic Infantry Combat Vehicle)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/ficv): sanctioned stage by Indian Army / AVNL / Private Industry. Tracked amphibious mechanized combat platform with 30mm auto-cannon and 5th-gen fire-and-forget ATGMs to replace BMP-2 Sarath vehicles.
- [WhAP / Kestrel (8x8 Wheeled Armoured Platform)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/whap-kestrel): production stage by DRDO (VRDE) / TASL / Mahindra. 8x8 modular wheeled amphibious combat vehicle with blast protection against IEDs, operational in high-altitude Ladakh and UN missions.
- [ATAGS (Advanced Towed Artillery Gun System - 155mm/52 Cal)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/atags): production stage by DRDO (ARDE) / Bharat Forge / TASL. World-leading 155mm/52-calibre towed howitzer with 25-litre chamber volume achieving unmatched 48 km range and rapid 3-round burst.
- [Mounted Gun System (MGS 155mm/52 Cal 8x8 Howitzer)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/mgs-155): trials stage by DRDO / Bharat Forge / TASL / BEML. Truck-mounted 155mm/52-calibre artillery system on high-mobility 8x8 chassis providing rapid shoot-and-scoot for desert and mountain borders.
- [K9 Vajra-T (155mm/52 Cal Tracked Howitzer Batch 2)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/k9-vajra-t): production stage by L&T Defence / Hanwha Aerospace. Tracked self-propelled 155mm howitzer equipped with indigenous winterization kits and high-altitude kits for deployment across Ladakh.

### Missiles & Strategic Deterrence
- [Project Kusha / ERADS (Indigenous Long-Range SAM)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/project-kusha): development stage by DRDO (DRDL / RCI) / IAF. India’s sovereign long-range surface-to-air missile system with 3 interceptors (150 km, 250 km, 350 km) against stealth jets, cruise missiles, and ballistic targets.
- [S-400 Triumf (Long-Range Air Defence Regiments)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/s400-triumf): induction stage by IAF / Almaz-Antey (Imported + Local Support). Tier-1 strategic multi-layered air defense shield operational across northern and eastern sectors with 400 km interception envelope.
- [Akash-NG (New Generation Surface-to-Air Missile)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/akash-ng): trials stage by DRDO (DRDL) / BDL / BEL. Canisterized quick-reaction SAM with dual-pulse motor and active RF seeker intercepting agile high-speed threats at 70-80 km.
- [QRSAM (Quick Reaction Surface-to-Air Missile)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/qrsam): trials stage by DRDO / BEL / BDL. Armoured mobile all-weather air defense system capable of searching and tracking on the move to protect tank columns.
- [VSHORADS (Very Short Range Air Defense System)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/vshorads): production stage by DRDO (RCI) / Adani Defence / ICOMM. 4th-generation man-portable air defense missile equipped with uncooled dual-band IIR seeker and Reaction Control System (RCS).
- [Astra BVR (Beyond Visual Range Air-to-Air: Mk1 / Mk2 / Mk3)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/astra-bvr): production stage by DRDO (DRDL / RCI) / BDL / IAF. All-weather air-to-air missile family: Mk1 (110 km inducted), Mk2 (160 km dual-pulse trials), and Mk3 (340 km SFDR ramjet).
- [BrahMos Supersonic Cruise Missile Suite (ER / NG / II)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/brahmos-supersonic): production stage by BrahMos Aerospace (DRDO / NPOM Joint Venture). World’s fastest supersonic operational cruise missile (Mach 3) with extended 450-800 km range and upcoming miniaturized BrahMos-NG for fighters.
- [Rudram NGARM (Next-Gen Anti-Radiation Missiles: I / II / III)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/rudram-anti-radiation): trials stage by DRDO (DRDL / RCI) / IAF. Air-launched supersonic anti-radiation missile to neutralize enemy radar installations, SAM batteries, and air defense command posts.
- [Pralay (Quasi-Ballistic Tactical Surface-to-Surface Missile)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/pralay-missile): production stage by DRDO / BDL. Solid-fuel quasi-ballistic missile with 150-500 km range capable of high-speed terminal maneuvers to defeat anti-ballistic interceptors along LAC/LoC.
- [Phase-II BMD (Ballistic Missile Defence: AD-1 & AD-2)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/phase-2-bmd): trials stage by DRDO (RCI / DRDL) / Strategic Forces Command. Two-stage long-range interceptor missile system capable of neutralizing 5,000 km class intermediate-range ballistic missiles in endo/exo-atmospheric regimes.

### Unmanned & AI Systems
- [Tapas-BH-201 & Archer-NG (MALE Armed Reconnaissance UAV)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/tapas-archer-uav): trials stage by DRDO (ADE) / HAL / BEL / Private Consortium. Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) surveillance and weaponized drone capable of 28,000 ft operations with SATCOM datalink and anti-tank missiles.
- [MQ-9B SkyGuardian & SeaGuardian (Tri-Service HALE Drones)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/mq9b-guardian): sanctioned stage by Ministry of Defence / General Atomics. High Altitude Long Endurance (HALE) drones with 40+ hour endurance, anti-submarine warfare suite, and Hellfire precision strike missiles.
- [ALFA-S & Autonomous Swarm Drone Systems](https://www.defencewire.in/program/alfa-s-swarms): trials stage by DRDO / NewSpace Research & Tech / HAL / IAF. Air-Launched Flexible Asset (ALFA-S) swarm drones deployed in swarms of 50+ from mother aircraft or ground canisters with AI mesh networking.
- [D-4 Anti-Drone System (Drone Detect, Deter & Destroy)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/d4-anti-drone): production stage by DRDO (DLRL / LASTEC) / BEL / Zen Tech. Comprehensive counter-UAS system featuring 360° radar detection, RF jamming, GNSS spoofing (soft-kill), and 10kW laser weapon (hard-kill).
- [DefSpace & SSA (Dedicated Military Satellite Constellation)](https://www.defencewire.in/program/defspace-satellites): development stage by Defence Space Agency (DSA) / ISRO / DRDO / Startups. Constellation of 52 dedicated military satellites (optical, SAR, ELINT) providing 24/7 high-cadence revisit over Indian Ocean and disputed borders.

## Institutional Source Reliability Tiers
1. Tier Official: Ministry of Defence (MoD), Press Information Bureau (PIB), DRDO, Indian Army/Navy/IAF official communications.
2. Tier 1 (Institutional): The Hindu, Indian Express, ANI, PTI, Livefist, Force Magazine, Janes, USNI News.
3. Tier 2 (General Media): Hindustan Times, Times of India, Business Standard, The Print, NDTV.
4. Tier Social: Verified OSINT analysts and institutional defence correspondents.
